subtitle: Out Manila · China Southern Airlines
overview: Fly with China Southern Airlines via Guangzhou to Hohhot, the capital of Inner Mongolia. See Xilamuren Grassland, the Yinken Whistling Dune Bay desert, the Genghis Khan Mausoleum and the Inner Mongolia Museum, and ski at Mazongshan Ski Resort with equipment included. Local 5-star hotels, private coach and English-speaking guide; a no-shopping package.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Jan 4–9 2027 to Feb 26–Mar 3 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Hohhot: The capital of Inner Mongolia in northern China, the base for this tour's grassland and city visits.
placeDesc.Xilamuren Grassland: A grassland resort area north of Hohhot, known for horse riding and Mongolian culture.
placeDesc.Heshuo Kejing Princess Mansion: A Qing-dynasty princess mansion near Hohhot showing the life of Mongolian nobility.
placeDesc.Yinken Whistling Dune Bay: A 5A-rated desert scenic area in Inner Mongolia with singing sand dunes; admission and cable car included.
placeDesc.Xiangshawan: A desert tourism area in Inner Mongolia; optional entertainment activities are offered here.
placeDesc.Genghis Khan Mausoleum: A memorial complex in Ordos dedicated to Genghis Khan.
placeDesc.Mengliang Folkland: A Hohhot folk-culture attraction presenting Mongolian life and traditions.
placeDesc.Mazongshan Ski Resort: A ski resort near Hohhot; the tour includes 3 hours of skiing with a full equipment set.
placeDesc.Inner Mongolia Museum: The regional museum in Hohhot covering the history and culture of Inner Mongolia.
placeDesc.Baoerhan Pagoda: A pagoda in Hohhot, visited instead of the museum when the museum is closed.
placeDesc.Kuan Alley Food Street: A pedestrian lane in Hohhot with local food and shops.
